vocabmatch.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: to put the name of a person in your post, with @
to ask a person to come to an event
all the people who see your posts
your page with your photo and information
a word with # that helps people find a post
a short address that you click

listenings.text: Hello, this is Tom from the Business Aviation Networking Night. Thank you for coming to our event in Miami. Now we have something new: an online event every month. The next one is on Tuesday, July seventh, at seven p.m., Miami time. It is free for all our guests. Click the link on our profile to join, and please invite a colleague. In September, we meet offline again, at the aviation fair in Sao Paulo. Don't forget to tag us in your photos. See you online!

Hi, it's Sofia from Texas again. People always ask me: how do you find new clients online? Here is my routine. I usually post on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. I never post without a good caption. I always use five hashtags, not thirty. My audience is small, only four thousand people, but they are real buyers. When a new person follows me, I visit their profile and I send a short message. Sometimes I make a mistake, like a wrong link. Then I say: I'm sorry about that, and I fix it the same day. Online is only the start. The deal happens offline, face to face.

extra_audio.text: First, Karina goes to the networking night in Miami. Then, she posts a photo and tags Mike. Next, a pilot from Dubai asks for her link. After that, Karina says sorry and fixes her profile. Finally, Mike invites her to his online event.
